verdicts.reason: The text says "remove it entirely (don't leave as \"N/A\")", which directly forbids leftover N/A lines in the spec.
"Maximum 3 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers" maps directly onto a max-3 count check.
"Specification written to `SPEC_FILE`" requires the spec artifact to exist.
"validated against quality checklist" implies the requirements checklist exists, and the check is already only a should.
"Run `.../setup-plan.sh --json` ... and parse JSON for FEATURE_SPEC, IMPL_PLAN, FEATURE_DIR, BRANCH" is an explicit required step.
"Phase 0: Generate research.md" requires research.md to exist.
"resolve all NEEDS CLARIFICATION" supports, at should level, that no unresolved markers remain in the plan's Technical Context.
"Generate data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md - always all three" makes data-model.md mandatory.
"always all three" makes quickstart.md mandatory.
"data-model.md ... with nothing to hold ... has the one-line body `N/A — <reason>`" defines the N/A body rule.
"quickstart.md with nothing to hold ... has the one-line body `N/A — <reason>`" defines the N/A body rule.
"contracts/ with no contract is recorded in plan.md's Documentation tree as `contracts/  # N/A — <reason>`" directly specifies the plan contracts rule.
"nothing is looked up online" directly supports a no-fetch check during the plan stage.
"Do not fetch links from the issue" is an explicit prohibition.
"a link you rely on is recorded as `[UNVERIFIED — not fetched]`" applies to links cited in research.md.
"a link you rely on is recorded as `[UNVERIFIED — not fetched]`" applies equally to links in plan.md.
"research.md with all NEEDS CLARIFICATION resolved" means no markers may remain in research.md.
The `<REPLACE in plan.md: …>` line must be replaced ("replace it in plan.md with one line per contract file"), so the residue must not remain.
"write no contract file and record `contracts/  # N/A — <reason>` in plan.md's Documentation tree" supports the contracts rule check.
"use project-relative paths for references in documentation" supports, at should level, banning absolute `/tmp/speckit-sdd/` paths in plan.md.
